description: Required topics for WPL-A 07 230 Premium with HSBC 300 cool (CAN B, 50 kbps, integrated WPM4). Upstream version verified on hardware 2026-11-23 (read-only, 120 s smoke window, 300 s baseline) with the upstream names; this fork copy uses the fork names (SPEICHER, WPUMPE, WW_ISTTEMPERATUR, WW_KOMFORT_TEMPERATUR, WW_ECO_TEMPERATUR, STATUS_WPLA) and is not yet re-verified. Derived from signal_requests_wpla7.h: only signals polled every 30 s or every minute, so they appear inside the 120 s smoke window. The WPL-A does not answer the MWh energy counters of the base table, so the energy sums, the COP values and MANAGER/WW_ECO are excluded from the common baseline. MANAGER/PROGRAMMSCHALTER appeared only after the first 120 s of the 300 s baseline and is excluded for the same reason.
